name: B10-0230/2024 (ECR) – Human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Kyrgyzstan, in particular the case of Temirlan Sultanbekov
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking the Kyrgyz authorities to act. It wants them to release opposition politician Temirlan Sultanbekov and other party officials held since before the November local elections, and to treat them fairly. It also asks Kyrgyzstan to protect media freedom and human rights, drop two laws it says target independent voices, and stop helping Russia avoid sanctions.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; these are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Kyrgyzstan's government, courts, media and opposition.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies and to Kyrgyzstan's government and parliament.
